definitions.est_dollar_volume: ESTIMATE = volume_fp x last_price_dollars, computed by this collector. The API exposes no single dollar-volume field. Label is shown in the UI.
definitions.usd_volume_24h: COMPUTED, not an API field: sum(count_fp x yes_price_dollars) over public trade prints (GET /markets/trades) whose created_time is inside the last 24 hours. Only computed for the markets listed in `trade_volume`.
definitions.orderbook_history: SAMPLED, not an API endpoint: /markets/{ticker}/orderbook is polled ~22 s apart by this collector. Kalshi publishes no orderbook history.
definitions.scope_limits: Per-topic cap on how many series were queried. A topic listed here has more series in the catalogue than were queried this run; nothing is dropped silently, the numbers are on the Verification page.
definitions.derived_yes_asks: Derived, not raw: a NO bid at price p is equivalent to a YES ask at 1-p (Kalshi orderbook docs). Shown so ask-side depth and spread are visible.
definitions.result: Official market field. 'yes' or 'no' once settled; empty while live.
definitions.derived_mid: Derived, not raw: (yes_bid_close + yes_ask_close) / 2 per candlestick. The candlestick `price` object is the TRADED price and is empty in any period with no trade, so this keeps the chart continuous without inventing a traded price.
